## Minutes publication

Delete this section if the pull request adds no document.

- [ ] The filename is `<YYYY-MM-DD>-minutes-<cc|dic|rc>.pdf` — lowercase, hyphens, no spaces.
- [ ] The date is the meeting date, and the committee code is the right one.
- [ ] The PDF has a text layer and is within the size budget (≤ 1 MB target, 5 MB limit).
- [ ] The document may be public and permanent in git history.
- [ ] Personal data that should not be published has been checked.
- [ ] CI (`build`) is green.

## Checks

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally, or CI is green.
- [ ] Documentation is updated if behaviour or authoring rules changed.
